name: terraform-release-state
description: GitHub Action for Terraform state storage using GitHub Release assets

scripts.build: rm -rf .build && trap 'rm -rf .build' EXIT; tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp .build/src/main.mjs .build/src/main.js && rm -f dist/index.mjs dist/index.mjs.map && XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.build/.cache" ncc build .build/src/main.js --minify --source-map --no-cache
scripts.format: biome format --write package.json src tests && prettier --write action.yml '.github/workflows/*.yml' '**/*.md'
scripts.format:check: biome format package.json commitlint.config.mjs src tests && prettier --check action.yml '.github/workflows/*.yml' '**/*.md'
scripts.lint: biome lint package.json commitlint.config.mjs src tests && markdownlint-cli2 '**/*.md' '#node_modules/**'
scripts.test: trap 'rm -rf .test-build' EXIT; tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.mts
